mentions.name: Financial literacy education book
mentions.description: A financial literacy/education book written with humor and easily comprehensible language that distills personal finance topics such as tax brackets, 401Ks, IRAs, ETFs, compounding interest, and debt management. Currently about a month in, with a chapter written each week and an ebook planned for release.
mentions.problem: People often know little about basic personal finance concepts like tax brackets, 401Ks, IRAs, ETFs, compounding interest, and debt management.
mentions.audience: People who know little about basic finances, such as the author's acquaintances, friends and family members.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I decided to write a financial literacy/education book with a bit of humor and easily comprehensible language to distill some of these topics. I'm about 1 month into it and try to write a chapter a week.

evidence.value: So I decided to write a financial literacy/education book with a bit of humor and easily comprehensible language to distill some of these topics. I'm about 1 month into it and try to write a chapter a week.
